name_zh: 马谢尔/弗雷利莫/解放战争：游击解放治理与社会主义建设
name_en: Machel/FRELIMO/Liberation War: Guerrilla Liberation Governance & Socialist Construction
description_zh: 萨莫拉·马谢尔 (1933-1986) 莫桑比克首任总统 (1975-1986)，弗雷利莫 (FRELIMO) 创始领袖，领导 1964-1974 十年武装斗争反葡殖民，1975 独立后推行马克思列宁主义/农业合作社/识字运动/免费医疗/妇女解放/反部落主义。1977-1992 内战(雷纳莫/南非/罗得西亚支持)/马谢尔 1986 空难/查卡诺接任/1992 罗马和平协议/多党制/市场经济。体现 M192 游击解放治理——以"人民战争+社会主义建设+识字动员+妇女解放"四位一体，在殖民战争/冷战代理人/自然灾害中构建解放政权。
description_en: Samora Machel (1933-1986) Mozambique first President (1975-1986), FRELIMO founder, led 1964-1974 decade armed struggle against Portuguese colonialism, 1975 independence implemented Marxism-Leninism/agricultural cooperatives/literacy campaigns/free healthcare/women's liberation/anti-tribalism. 1977-1992 civil war (RENAMO/South Africa/Rhodesia backing)/Machel 1986 plane crash/Chissano succeeds/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market economy. Exemplifies M192 Guerrilla Liberation Governance—quaternity of 'people's war + socialist construction + literacy mobilization + women's liberation' constructing liberation regime amid colonial war/Cold War proxy/natural disasters.
reason_zh: 马谢尔非单纯解放领袖，而是"人民战争+社会主义建设+新人塑造"三位一体革命政治家。以游击战建立政权合法性，以社会主义建设重构社会结构，以识字/妇女解放创造革命新人。M192 区隔于 M186 泛非(恩克鲁玛)、M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)、M190 矿区武装(卡比拉)，核心在于"人民战争即建国合法性+社会主义即社会重构+新人塑造即革命延续"的南非解放范式。
reason_en: Machel not mere liberation leader but trinity of 'people's war + socialist construction + new human creation' revolutionary statesman. People's war established regime legitimacy, socialist construction restructured society, literacy/women's liberation created revolutionary new human. M192 distinct from M186 Pan-African (Nkrumah), M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), M190 Mining Warlord (Kabila), core: 'people's war as nation-building legitimacy + socialism as social reconstruction + new human creation as revolutionary continuity' southern African liberation paradigm.
steps_zh: 人民战争建立合法性：1964-74 武装斗争/弗雷利莫游击战/坦赞铁路/前线基地/国际团结/1975 独立，武装斗争即建国合法性
社会主义建设与社会重构：农业合作社/国有化/免费医疗/教育/妇女组织/青年旅/反部落/反酋长/新社会主义人塑造
识字动员与文化革命：1978 识字运动/成人教育/葡萄牙语/本土语言/革命文化/歌曲/戏剧/壁画/革命精神普及
妇女解放与性别革命：妇女组织(OMM)/婚姻法/继承权/堕胎权/反割礼/反多妻/政治参与/军队/政府/教育，性别革命深度
内战与遗产：1977-92 雷纳莫/南非/罗得西亚代理人战争/马谢尔 1986 空难/查卡诺 1990 放弃马克思/1992 罗马和约/多党/市场/马谢尔精神延续
steps_en: People's war establishes legitimacy: 1964-74 armed struggle/FRELIMO guerrilla/Tazara railway/frontline bases/international solidarity/1975 independence, armed struggle = nation-building legitimacy
Socialist construction & social reconstruction: agricultural cooperatives/nationalization/free healthcare/education/women's org/youth leagues/anti-tribal/anti-chief/new socialist human creation
Literacy mobilization & cultural revolution: 1978 literacy campaign/adult education/Portuguese/indigenous languages/revolutionary culture/songs/drama/murals/revolutionary spirit普及
Women's liberation & gender revolution: women's org (OMM)/marriage law/inheritance/abortion rights/anti-FGM/anti-polygamy/political participation/military/govt/education, gender revolution depth
Civil war & legacy: 1977-92 RENAMO/South Africa/Rhodesia proxy war/Machel 1986 plane crash/Chissano 1990 abandons Marxism/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market/Machel spirit endures
expected_zh: 以"人民战争+社会主义建设+识字动员+妇女解放"四位一体，在殖民战争/冷战代理人/自然灾害中构建解放政权，留下革命道德权威超越政权的非洲领袖范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'people's war + socialist construction + literacy mobilization + women's liberation' constructs liberation regime amid colonial war/Cold War proxy/natural disasters, leaving revolutionary moral authority transcending regime African leader paradigm.
case_zh: 1964 武装斗争/1975 独立/1977-92 内战/1986 马谢尔空难/1992 罗马和约/多党制/市场经济/萨莫拉·马谢尔大桥/革命精神代际传承，解放政权在战争中存续。
case_en: 1964 armed struggle/1975 independence/1977-92 civil war/1986 Machel plane crash/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market economy/Samora Machel Bridge/revolutionary spirit intergenerational transmission, liberation regime endures through war.
